description: Search verified local businesses on Loomivo by what they do and where. Use this first when the customer has not named a specific business (e.g. 'a dentist in Karaikal'); if they named one, search for its name. Returns up to 20 businesses with their slug (needed by get_business, get_available_times and create_request), type, town, and 'can': what customers can do online ('book', 'order', 'quote'; 'request' for a free listing whose owner confirms within 24 hours; null if not taking requests). Read-only, no side effects. No sign-in or API key needed. Rate limit: 600 read calls and 60 create_request calls per hour per client IP; over the limit you get error -32000 'Too many requests' (wait, then retry).

city.description: Town or city name, exact match, any case. Optional.

query.description: What the customer wants, or the business's name. Words like 'dentist', 'salon', 'seafood restaurant', 'Sea Shell'. May be empty to list everything in a town.

name: search_businesses
title: Search local businesses
